description: This file defines a class `GLVertex` representing a 3D vertex with position and color, including methods for equality check, coordinate transformation, and buffer updates. It is part of an Android graphics demo project.

classes.name: GLVertex
classes.description: Represents a vertex in 3D space with position (x, y, z), an index, and optional color data. Provides methods to convert coordinates to fixed-point, compare vertices, and update buffers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another object is a `GLVertex` with the same position coordinates.

methods.name: toFixed
methods.description: Converts a float coordinate to a fixed-point integer representation.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Writes the vertex's position and color data into provided buffers.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the vertex position in a buffer, optionally applying a transformation.
